entities.name: Change of UE's usage setting procedure
entities.description: Procedure executed by UE in single-registration mode when UE's usage setting changes. Involves enabling/disabling N1 mode capability based on usage setting change and access type.

entities.name: UE usage setting
entities.description: UE configuration parameter that can be either 'voice centric' or 'data centric'.

entities.name: IMS voice availability
entities.description: Condition indicating whether IMS voice service is available over the access type.

entities.name: N1 mode capability for 3GPP access
entities.description: UE capability for N1 mode operation over 3GPP access, which can be enabled or disabled.

entities.name: N1 mode capability for non-3GPP access
entities.description: UE capability for N1 mode operation over non-3GPP access, which can be enabled or disabled.

entities.name: UE registration status
entities.description: Condition describing whether UE is registered over 3GPP access only, non-3GPP access only, or both access types.

entities.name: Persistent PDU session
entities.description: Condition where UE has an ongoing persistent PDU session that requires special handling during capability changes.

relations.description: Procedure execution is triggered by changes in UE usage setting.
Procedure behavior depends on IMS voice availability condition.
Procedure can disable or re-enable N1 mode capability for 3GPP access.
Procedure can disable or re-enable N1 mode capability for non-3GPP access.
Procedure execution depends on UE's current registration status over access types.
Procedure execution may be delayed if UE has persistent PDU session until radio bearer is released.
